levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن يحيى العطار

notes: «6-» is a number and «رضي الله عنهم» a blessing: left out
the three names before «قالوا» are one level of co-transmitters
Abu Jafar al-Umari narrates; the Imam Abu Muhammad speaks inside his story («قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ ع») so he is the last link (owner ruling 5); «ع» abbreviates «عليه السلام»
